Cam (People Ops): Quick update: the FYQ2 review window overlaps with a regional holiday in LATAM (Apr 10-12). We have 4 new hires (<90 days) and a couple of reviewer conflicts. Proposing: 1) Auto-exempt new hires from full calibration sampling but collect manager notes, 2) Offer a 72h rolling extension for reviewers in holiday regions, 3) Run a condensed calibration for those who took extensions. Need quick ack+volunteers.

Riley Tran: Ack. For new hires, do we still capture baseline goals?

Cam (People Ops): Yes 90-day hires: capture manager baseline + peer inputs (optional). We'll tag those records `NH-BASE`. They won't be in the anonymized calibration pool but will be included in comp inputs.

Zoe Park: I'll volunteer to run the condensed calibration (3090m) for extended reviewers. CET evenings ok.

Amir K.: Can reviewers claim extension on behalf of manager if manager is OOO?

Cam (People Ops): No 95% of the time manager sign-off still required. For urgent holiday delegation, managers must pre-authorize a delegate via the template here: https://redwood.internal/people-ops/delegate-template. Use code `HOL-EXT-72` when submitting exception.

People Ops Bot: Reminder: review forms auto-lock in 96 hours for the global pool. Use exception flow early to avoid escalations.

Sienna Moore: Two reviewers on my team will be on leave Apr 11. I can cover one extra bundle. Where to sign up?

Cam (People Ops): Thanks Sienna 95 add to the LATAM swap sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/LATAM-swaps. Sheet columns: Name | Bundles | Timezone | NH-BASE? | Delegate? | Notes. Example CSV for systems team if you want to bulk ingest: 

reviewer_name,reviewer_email,bundles_assigned,timezone,flags
Sienna Moore,sienna@redwood.ai,1,GMT-3,OVR,
Zoe Park,zoe@redwood.ai,1,CET,COND-ANCHOR

Riley Tran: For the condensed calibration, what's the expected prep?

Zoe Park: I'll prep a 5-case packet and a 15m anchors-only sync. Should be quick.

HR Systems Bot: Note: new hires under 90 days will be marked `NH-BASE` in People Ops DB; they will be excluded from auto-sampling. Managers still need to submit baseline notes.

Cam (People Ops): Operational checklist for volunteers: 1) Confirm access to review form and swap sheet, 2) Mark `EXT-HOL` when you take a rolling extension, 3) If you cover NHs, add baseline note `NH-BASE` in manager comments, 4) Join condensed calibration if you're flagged `EXT-HOL`.

Amir K.: I'll take one bundle and can be backup for condensed calibrations late CET.

Cam (People Ops): Thanks all. I'll post a final roster and the condensed calibration invite by EOD. If you need People Ops to pre-fill delegation email to your director, DM me and I'll send a draft.
